items.title: PTC Industries wins ~400 tonne domestic defence titanium order
items.text: PTC Industries disclosed to NSE a domestic defence contract to supply about 400 tonnes of titanium ingots, bars and rods, to be executed over the next 12 months through subsidiary Aerolloy Technologies. Order value and the end platform were not disclosed, citing strategic and confidentiality considerations. It is a sizeable volume against India's thin domestic titanium base, and it supports PTC's ingot-to-mill-product titanium story, though sponge feedstock sourcing was not addressed.
